verdict.rationale: Docs confirm typo tolerance is enabled by default (docs-3, docs-37, docs-60) and is tunable per index via minWordSizeForTypos and other settings (docs-22, docs-31), giving developers control over when/how fuzzy matching applies. Community feedback (comm-10) corroborates a 'zero config' experience, though no independent test specifically stresses typo-matching edge cases. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of typo-tolerance accuracy/limits and more detail on advanced tuning knobs beyond minWordSizeForTypos.
